verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing for a SaaS platform with a public developer API to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST APIs, token auth, webhooks, an official MCP server, Postman collections and Zapier/Pipedream/Workato integrations, but no first-party command-line tool. The MCP server and API are adjacent capabilities or building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.
